g.text: card_experiment_01 · apiVersion wyrd/v1 · read-only projection of server truth
No runs have been recorded for this Experiment yet.
The declaration below is complete and active. Runs arrive when the SDK, an Agent
workflow, or a Trigger executes against this Experiment — this page has no execution
control and never will start work itself.
WHEN RUNS ARRIVE, THIS OVERVIEW SHOWS
· run counts by lifecycle state and the authored summary (summary_metrics · best_run_ref)
· recent activity with links into each run's inspection sections
· recorded outputs — metrics, tables, visuals, files and registered Artifact Cards
Expected run kinds for this definition: training · workflow · offline_eval · drift_check
No outputs exist before the first run — stated as absent, not zero.
Comparison needs at least two compatible completed runs.
